slice_map.rule: SETID 0 enters at dvs_W5; slice k latches id k (qfd_dv_slice2 SETID: id, forward id + 1)

X.what: residual x rows (owned o / down blocks, ascending global block)

SSX.what: root: the 32-slot total spill (ROOT ss; unused with fuse 1)

RX.what: rb landing: r = rsqrt(sum / 4096 + eps) (ROOT rx, every slice)

T.what: AR landing of t (owned o / down rows, AR calendar order = owned order)

QKV.what: qkv receiver: the head block the L9 station lands (q head / k / v)

GU.what: gate block s (0..127) + up block s (128..255): the L7 station landing

ATT.what: attention output block i (o_proj x elements 128 i ..) landed from the D2D return chain (dd_en window, dd_base = ATT - 128 i)

PS1.what: post-TP scale of the o rows the slice owns (residual 1)

PS2.what: post-TP scale of the down rows the slice owns (residual 2)

ROPE.what: (cos, sin) of the token position (rewritten per token)

isa.norm_fold: qkv / gu matvecs read raw X (PC1 / PC16 me_xbase); r multiplies V (PC3), q/k (PC4), gate/up (PC18)

ages.source: rtl/test/qwen_dv/dv_lower_vec_bench.py --mode calibrate (tb_qfd_dv2 N 12, Verilator 5.050). Offsets from the slice cmd landing (entry + 2 s): PSUM = leave edge of the slice dn_o (S<s>SD); x = edge at the E5 end (S11E) - 2 (11 - s); D2D = edge at W5 (S0DD) - 2 s; d2d rs / qn / gur are the VM-only ops re-targeted to the D2D window (same pipeline) = their last-write ages; red_vm = the head SSQ reducer result (PSUM-window variant) age

assumptions: AR return calendar slice-major (slice 0 owned blocks ascending, then slice 1, ...): the io_collective all-reduce must return the reduced t words in this order (the return word has no address)
D2D addresses: q = global q row (128 head + i), k / v = head-dim index; the KV die adds the token position (its own landing)
slice 11 x words also leave east at the E5 chain end (st_up_o of dvs_E5: no consumer on the die)
not_lowered: STN commands of qkv / o / gu / down / LM head (the station landings QKV / GU / AR this lowering reads are their contract: sibling QLB-C4b/3b)
head-row (hr / xpf) control of the column heads that consume the x stream
splice into the ctlm decode calendar
die_gaps: dvs_W5.st_wi tied 0 on the die (dv_lower die_gaps): the PROG and CROM table words this lowering emits (incl. the per-token RoPE row) have no load path on the die
